readingMode: All 16 pages directly read sequentially, including complete contents, contributor list, all five policy sections and ending. Original page 1 title/logo/legal text visually read; no nonrecurring image on other pages.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Original first page visually read: Revuelta logo, August 2019 title and treaty/constitutional excerpts. Native extraction includes a draft-text label absent from the visible heading; metadata also names a v8 draft. Legal quotations are publisher rationale, not verified current law.
Complete five-part contents read, with assembly, concern and demands sections and printed references.

Complete June 22, 2019 association/contributor list read, including Jaén Merece Más and numbered placeholders. Membership alone is not 2023 adoption by every platform or personal reviewer credentials.

Full demographic diagnosis and State-pact proposal, ministry or secretary of state, and earmarked 7% of income/corporate/wealth tax receipts for an estimated 30 years without higher overall taxation. This differs from later model 1% of GDP financing; do not merge quantities.
EU financing/tax treatment analogous to outermost regions and political-warning passage. Historical legislature reference is not a new 2023 demand or guaranteed consequence.
Full demands and 2021-2027 funding amendment discussion; two diagnosis axes of long-term population loss and low density. Economic/causal assertions attributed, not verified.
Completes diversification rationale; full low-population-area definition using density, social/economic and time dimensions, beyond only 8/12.5 inhabitants per km² thresholds.

Completes local/comarca scale and immediate-investment proposal; earmarked funds/control and independent territorial agencies modelled on Scottish Highlands. Comparative success is a source assertion.

Completes agency monitoring/local-action groups; 2017 motion and Law 45/2007 revival, decentralised administration/public-company headquarters; begins transport rationale. Motion and law are distinct.

Complete infrastructure-study discussion and basic health/education/social/security services within 30 minutes, with sustainable comarca mobility and cost/use/impact evaluation. No universal fare entitlement.

High-capacity road access within 30 km, pending 2012-24 works, mesh corridors and public/social conventional passenger-freight railway, criticising endpoint-only high-speed priority. Territory-wide connectivity and rural 5G priority are not universal free internet.

Completes connectivity argument and economic diversification; one-stop business procedures, differentiated rural taxes/public-fee relief and employer contribution rebates. No blanket personal contribution exemption.

Continues resident income-tax and business support; rural banking/soft loans, farming policy for active family farms/youth/women, skills and social economy. Conditions are rural/sectoral, not national universal abolition.

Completes social economy; territorial compensation, carbon-sink compensation and corporate territorial responsibility; begins universal rural service package comparable in access/quality. No exact expanded dental/free-price entitlement.

Full rural social-service financing, assisted technology/home services, professional career incentives and security staffing. Housing rehabilitation aid may depend on renting, with an optional publicly managed rental pool. No rent ceilings, compulsory letting or permanent public ownership.

Complete rural-image/empowerment section and ending, including linked/seasonal population, local belonging and education/media. Cultural argument and claimed effects remain attributed; no additional annex/footnote after ending.

Hidden native draft label differs from visible August 2019 heading; preserve metadata/extraction without silently editing the original.
Treaty, law, statistics and causal/economic effects are quoted publisher claims, not independently verified current facts.
authorship: Direct full agent reading and authored contextual notes; supplied literal offsets/hashes are deterministic only. No generated question or position.
